project_config.status: Not fabricated as of 2026-10-12. Fab house: JLCPCB (jlcpcb/ - KiCad JLCPCB plugin, state in jlcpcb/project.db).
project_config.description: USB-powered base station that programs a tag over SWD and charges the tag's LiPo cell through the 6-pin tagpoint connector J101.
project_config.name: tagbase-lipo-v1
project_config.board: 4 layer, 50.95 x 70.00 mm, 1.6 mm. In1.Cu = +3V3 plane, In2.Cu = GND plane, F.Cu/B.Cu GND pours.
